about: Human decisions fixing brickschema's output in the ground truth. 'rules' break ties and fire only when an entity's candidate set equals when_candidates exactly. 'corrections' replace a single wrong match and fire only when brickschema returned when_class and the entity has every tag in when_tags_all. Edit freely; rebuild with scripts/build_golden.py.
decided: 2026-11-08, proposed by Claude on the user's instruction; GT-001..GT-010 approved by the user as is on 2026-11-08; GC-001..GC-002 requested by the user on 2026-11-08

rules.rationale: Entity is tagged vav; the thermostat tag marks that the box does zone temperature control, not that it is a thermostat.
Same pattern as GT-001: fcu is the equipment type, thermostat describes its control.
Tagged both ahu and rtu; RTU is the more specific type (a packaged rooftop air handler).
The elec tag means the unit is electrically powered; it does not make it electrical-distribution equipment.
Tags are occupied + cooling + zone + air + temp + sp; Brick 1.4.4 has this exact class, which brickschema's tag table missed.
Same as GT-007 for the unoccupied setpoint.
The point drives a (reheat) valve. Brick 1.4.4 has no heating-valve command class; the heating role is carried by the equipment and the hot-water feed.
Same as GT-009 for chilled-water valves.

corrections.rationale: Plain zone occupancy commands ('Occupied status', 'Mode_Occ'); nothing in the tags or names is about load shedding. brickschema's tag table over-matches.
brickschema's class is deprecated in Brick 1.4.4 and drops the heating tag; this is the exact class for unocc + heating + zone + air + temp + sp.
